verdict.rationale: Aircall's own power-dialer capability supports a bulk import of up to 1,000 numbers that are then dialed in sequence, and the API exposes Campaign create/launch/pause/resume endpoints that act on that batch as a unit. This is narrow, telephony-specific batch handling rather than general bulk operations across items. missing for 10: general bulk update/delete across records (calls, contacts, users), batch API endpoints, documentation of bulk-operation limits and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import up to 1,000 numbers and dial them in sequence, with time between calls for notes and tags.
